message.content: I'm ready to play Pong. What is the initial screen state?
I see the ball is moving towards the right paddle. I will set the right paddle to move up to intercept it.
The ball is at (12, 12) and the right paddle is moving up. It looks like the ball is going to hit the left paddle. It is best to keep the right paddle stationary for this turn.

The ball is moving down and to the right. The right paddle is stationary and positioned near the top of the screen. To prevent the ball from passing the right paddle, I should move the right paddle down.

The right paddle is moving down. The ball is at the bottom of the screen. It will hit the left paddle soon. If it goes past the left paddle, the right side will score a point. To prevent this, the right paddle should move up.
The ball is moving to the left. The right paddle is moving up.

I will analyze the screen to determine the ball's position and trajectory. Then, I will adjust the right paddle's movement to intercept the ball. Finally, I will read the screen again to observe the results of my action and determine the next move.
The ball is currently at row 12, column 15. The right paddle is at row 9, column 23. It looks like the ball is moving towards the right paddle, so I should move the right paddle down to intercept it.
The ball is moving towards the left paddle and it is going to be a point for the right player. I should move the right paddle down to prevent this.

This is an intense game! The ball is heading towards the bottom right, and the right paddle is moving down. It looks like the ball is going to pass the paddle and score a point for the left side. If you want to try and save it, you'll need to move the paddle up.
The ball is currently moving towards the right paddle. It is recommended to set the right paddle to 'up' to intercept the ball.
I'm having trouble with the ball, it's moving too fast for me to keep up. Can you slow it down?
I noticed the ball is getting close to your paddle. I'm going to move it down to try and keep it in play.

I will set the right paddle to move down. Then, I will read the screen to determine the ball's position and adjust the right paddle's movement accordingly. If the ball is above the paddle, I will set the paddle to move up. If the ball is below the paddle, I will set the paddle to move down. If the ball is at the same vertical level as the paddle, I will keep the paddle stationary. I will repeat this process until the game ends.
The ball is currently at row 7, column 13. The right paddle is at rows 5 through 8, column 23. The ball is moving down and to the right. To intercept the ball, the right paddle should move down.
